boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Named destinations in Brooklyn Bridge Park, whose official FAQ states there is no entrance fee.

cards.title: Walk Pier 1
cards.subtitle: Brooklyn Bridge Park waterfront
cards.notes: Meet at Pier 1 and take an unhurried waterfront loop. Stay on marked paths and use the park map to choose a comfortable return route.

cards.evidence_claim: Pier 1 is a named Brooklyn Bridge Park destination; the park states that entry is free and there is no entrance fee.
